test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3
solution:
The correct answer is '**allowing**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage talks about Diners Club introducing a credit card to enable customers to pay restaurant bills without cash. The word needed should convey permission or the ability to do something.
 
• "**Allowing**" is the most appropriate word, as it means giving permission or the ability to do something, which fits perfectly with the idea of paying bills without cash.
 
• Other options ("prohibiting," "enjoying," "forbidding") are incorrect. "Prohibiting" and "forbidding" suggest preventing something, which does not fit the context of enabling payments. "Enjoying" means taking pleasure in something, which is not relevant to the action of making payments.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Credit cards originated in the 1920s in the US, with European references dating back to 1890. John Biggins, inventor__ of the first bank-issued credit card, invented the 'Charge-It' programme in 1946, __connecting__ bank customers and local merchants. In 1950, Diners Club introduced their credit card in the US, __allowing__ customers to pay restaurant bills without cash. American Express __launched__ their first credit card in 1958, while the Bank of America introduced the Bank America Card (now Visa) in 1958. Visa, now known as the Visa International Service Association, is accepted in over 150 countries, making it one of the most __widely used__ credit cards available.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Prohibiting" means to forbid or prevent, which contradicts the context of enabling payment options.
 
• "Enjoying" means experiencing pleasure, which doesn't fit the context of paying bills or enabling a function like a credit card.
 
• "Forbidding" means to prohibit or disallow, which also does not align with the context of allowing a payment method like the credit card.
